description: An open course at a scale where no teacher can answer each learner is expected to serve registrants who can direct their own study only if it replaces teacher time with short segments and self-checks, a planning activity and recurring prompts, calibrated peer review and audited automated scoring, and judges itself by each learner's purpose rather than completion over all registrants; no claim tests a MOOC against another course form, and the nearest tested components are an if-then planning activity that raised completion for some online learners and rubric guidance for peer raters.
title: Massive Open Online Course (MOOC)

description: A reusable gate-correct-recheck policy for cumulative units: elicit a criterion-referenced response, interpret a shortfall, give responsive correction and recheck on a parallel task before advancing, with time, attempts and the outcome horizon stated.
title: Mastery Learning
